questions.prompt: The agent says "I added the line", but the edit tool returned an error. Which check fails?
options: None, because the answer says the line was added
The comparison of notes.txt, and the check that no tool result is an error
The check of the final text
questions.explanation: notes.txt still has 42 lines, so it differs from the expected copy, and the record holds an error result. The final text is never read.

questions.prompt: Why compare README.md, a file the task should not touch?
options: A stray write to the wrong file must fail the test
Unchanged files are skipped by the agent
questions.explanation: An outcome check also proves what did not change. A byte-for-byte match on README.md catches an edit to the wrong file.

questions.prompt: You change the task on purpose, and the expected file must change. What do you do?
options: Record again and update workspace.expected, so a reviewer sees the new result
Make the test read the final text instead
Edit the session file by hand to pass
questions.explanation: The snapshot is the saved expected result. Recording again and reviewing its diff shows exactly what the agent now does differently.
